description: Cited answer to a question: Exa searches the web and writes an answer with the sources it used. Returns the answer, a citations array (title, URL, published date) and the upstream cost. Example: exa_answer({ query: "What is the current federal funds target range?" })

examples.query: What is the current federal funds target range?

_apiKey.description: Optional, your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema (Draft 7); the answer is then a structured object matching it.

query.description: The question or instruction to answer.

system_prompt.description: Optional extra instructions guiding the answer.

text.description: If true, include the full page text on each citation. Default false.

name: exa_answer

answer.description: The answer: a string, or an object matching output_schema

text.description: Page text, when text is set

costDollars.description: Upstream cost breakdown in USD as reported by the vendor

title: Exa Answer
